image_description: A light blue, reusable cloth diaper (nappy) lying flat on a neutral beige surface. The diaper features a smooth, satin-like inner lining and elasticized leg openings with gathered ruffles made of a grey/white checkered or textured fabric. The waistband also appears elasticized. There are no visible adhesive tabs, suggesting it is a pull-on style or the tabs are hidden/velcro-based on the sides.

The transition between the blue inner lining and the checkered outer trim on the left side appears slightly fused or ill-defined, with the edge bleeding into the background more than physically plausible for a thick elastic cuff.

To audit the complex boundary between the elasticated ruffles and the background, checking for edge bleeding or fusion artifacts common in AI generation.

Check if the pattern warps unnaturally or dissolves into noise. Also, verify if the 'satiny' sheen on the blue part is consistent with the lighting direction.
